text: Everything is an illusion in the mundane world. Only your conviction is real.
author: Shibumi
visual_brief: A precision technical cross-section of a heavy brass plumb bob suspended dead center within three concentric gimbal rings. Fine dashed alignment crosshairs and circular rotation arrows show the outer rings spinning in turbulent multi-axis motion while the central weight hangs absolute and undisturbed.
alt: Technical diagram of a static plumb bob centered inside spinning gimbal rings.
